 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 30.11.2023 failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 26.02.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 02.06.2021 passed by the learned ACJM-IV, Patna in connection with Sri Krishnapuri P.S. Case No. 98 of 2020 whereby cognizance of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61098 of 2022(2) dt.10-11-2023 offences under Section 341, 323, 498A, 504 and 34 of the IPC has been taken, shall remain stayed.

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 is mother-in-law of the O.P.
No. 2 and petitioner no. 2 is husband of the O.P. No. 2.
It is next submitted that the O.P. No. 2 after 18 years of marriage has instituted the aforesaid complaint.

6. The learned counsel for the petitioners, at this stage, submits that in the quashing application, the address of the O.P. No. 2 has been recorded as per the FIR, it is next submitted that the said address is her matrimonial home but presently she is not staying in her matrimonial home and has shifted to her parental home and thus seeks permission add the present address of the O.P. No. 2 in the quashing application.
7. Permission is accorded.
